entry.title: Monumental entrance remains, Villa Romana del Casale

groundCutout.basis: Four exact occupied pier footprints only; no mask spans a passage, lawn or approach.

buildingCutout.basis: Shared site Q505617 identifies this ancient entrance within park way304804695. Four integral piers are independently mapped as ways304818582,304818577,304818576 and304818580/native35184676907414,35184676907409,35184676907408 and35184676907412. Anchor uses the inner eastern pier way304818576; the other three retain their exact offsets. Internal +X follows the outer-pier row east/slightly south and +Z points south/slightly west across the approach. Native east/up/south axes are baked with heading0. Only the four pier records are replaced; all three passages and every other mapped building remain.

terrainReference.basis: Qualified approximate native exterior fit on original Protomaps20261020/Mapzen 201x201/6m ground. Open front provider[-4,7] supplies542.9866028097036m datum. Four-pier boundary grades -0.640..+0.678m relative; individual closed footings sit0.16m below their own boundary minima and rubble bases follow local center ground+0.06m. Current native views show supported broken piers with minor base exposure/burial, three clear passages and unchanged lawn/path approaches. Only the four occupied footprints are masked; all39 resident /40 wider independent buildings, original ground/roads and empty water layer remain. Exact archaeological heights, fractures, stone inventories, thresholds/paving and accessibility are unverified. No intact arch reconstruction, bespoke terrain or flattening.
